items.title: Official Claude plugins
items.description: Anthropic's official plugin marketplace. Needed by anyone who wants the standard Claude Code plugins listed in this catalog.
items.name: claude-plugins-official

items.title: Ponytail marketplace
items.description: Marketplace that hosts the ponytail plugin. Needed only if you want the minimal-code ponytail mode.
items.name: ponytail

items.title: Frontend design
items.description: Helps Claude produce distinctive, polished frontend interfaces. Useful for anyone building web UIs.
items.name: frontend-design@claude-plugins-official

items.title: Context7
items.description: Gives Claude up-to-date library and framework documentation on demand. Useful for anyone working with fast-moving dependencies.
items.name: context7@claude-plugins-official

items.title: Playwright
items.description: Lets Claude drive a real browser to test and inspect web pages. Useful for web development and UI verification.
items.name: playwright@claude-plugins-official

items.title: CLAUDE.md management
items.description: Audits and improves CLAUDE.md files and captures session learnings into them. Useful for anyone who maintains project instructions.
items.name: claude-md-management@claude-plugins-official

items.title: Code review
items.description: Adds a command that reviews a pull request or a change set. Useful for catching problems before merging.
items.name: code-review@claude-plugins-official

items.title: Code simplifier
items.description: Simplifies and cleans up recently changed code without changing behavior. Useful after larger edits.
items.name: code-simplifier@claude-plugins-official

items.title: Feature development
items.description: Guided workflow for building a feature: explore, design, implement, review. Useful for larger changes.
items.name: feature-dev@claude-plugins-official

items.title: Postman
items.description: Connects Claude to Postman for API collections and requests. Useful for API engineering work.
items.name: postman@claude-plugins-official

items.title: Ponytail
items.description: Switches Claude into a lazy-senior-developer mode that writes the smallest complete change. Useful if you want less code and fewer extras.
items.name: ponytail@ponytail

items.title: jscpd skill
items.description: Teaches Claude to find copy-pasted code with the jscpd tool. Useful for any codebase where duplication matters.
items.name: jscpd

items.title: DRY refactoring skill
items.description: Teaches Claude to remove duplicates found by jscpd without changing behavior. Useful together with the jscpd skill.
items.name: dry-refactoring

items.title: No AI attribution
items.description: Empties the commit and pull request attribution in Claude's user settings so commits carry only your git identity. Useful if you do not want AI credit lines in history.

items.title: Dev team
items.description: The author's agent team: a lead plus specialist roles such as researcher and debater, with a model and effort per role. Useful for splitting larger tasks across subagents.
items.name: Dev team
